gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-bengal: Expressive and a bit artful, Bushcraft draws every curve at a flat weight with generous gaps between characters. Noto Sans Bengali is the open-mouthed counterpart, its capitals barely taller than lowercase, which gives the pair its quiet strength.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-bhaiks: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki reads approachably, its lowercase swollen and tight like coiled rope, with apertures that stay easy to follow. Bushcraft stands opposite with no pressure swells at all, and the body text can go a touch larger to let those openings breathe.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi sets its mean line high and looks open-ended. Against Bushcraft's closed letters and constant-width arms and legs, the body wants a generous size so those curves can unfurl.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-bugine: Bushcraft has a sign-painter's-stencil flatness, every line the same weight, set against open letter mouths below it. Noto Sans Buginese has short ascenders, so give it a little extra size.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Wide, flat and a little wild. Bushcraft has closed letters, while Noto Sans Buhid leaves generous space between curve ends and the stem, and its high x-height guide makes it best for big, short lines.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-carian: Bushcraft's diagonals carry the same heft as its stems, giving it a stubborn, uniform look. Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades, so one handles big short lines and the other handles the rest.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Stretched out, flat-lined and artistic. Bushcraft is made for loud, closed shapes in big short bursts, while Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase up toward the caps and keeps its s and c uncrowded for steady reading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-cham: Expressive from the first letter, Bushcraft spaces everything out and keeps its capitals low-key against the lowercase. Noto Sans Cham brings open c shapes and tall rounded forms, so a long passage would move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-cherok: Noto Sans Cherokee forms a tall band of letters with short stalks above and a wide gap at the e's terminal. Over a long passage it feels approachable, while Bushcraft's flat, single-weight linework stays out of its way up top.
